root_cause: A single ARM64 CPU functional test (smoke_MatMulCompressedWeights_Kleidiai_i8_kernel_switch, i8 weights/f32 decompression/dynamic scale) expects the matmul to be executed by the KleidiAI-accelerated implementation but the selected primitive reports an 'undef_f32' impl type instead, i.e. the expected kernel-switch/fusion to the KleidiAI backend did not happen for this parameter combination on this run. This is unrelated to PR #40095, which only touches Intel NPU plugin (NPUW) transformation files; the same signature has recurred 4 times across unrelated PRs since 2026-11-13, consistent with a flaky/non-deterministic KleidiAI kernel-selection heuristic on ARM64 rather than a regression introduced by this change.
reproduction_steps: On an ARM64 (aarch64) build with KleidiAI enabled, run: ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter=*smoke_MatMulCompressedWeights_Kleidiai_i8_kernel_switch*CompareWithRefs*data_shape=*1.1.32*1.5.32*weights_shape=32,3*weights_precision=i8*decompression_precision=f32*decompression_multiply=full* . The test is intermittent; may require several repeats to reproduce the undef_f32 impl-type selection.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed job (this is a known recurring flaky test unrelated to the PR's NPU-only changes); merging should not be blocked on it.

Investigate the KleidiAI kernel-switch heuristic in src/plugins/intel_cpu/tests/functional/custom/subgraph_tests/src/classes/matmul_weights_decompression.cpp and the underlying primitive-selection logic for the i8/f32/dynamic-scale/full-decompression-multiply parameter combination to understand why it non-deterministically falls back to undef_f32 instead of kleidiai.
Consider marking this specific parameterized case as disabled/quarantined until the kernel-selection flakiness is root-caused, to stop it from intermittently failing unrelated merge-queue runs.
prevention_strategies: Add retry-on-flaky-test handling or quarantine for ARM64 KleidiAI matmul-decompression smoke tests until the kernel-selection non-determinism is fixed; track the pattern via repo-memory to confirm it is not a regression trend before next escalation threshold.
historical_context: This exact signature has now been seen 4 times (2026-11-13, 2026-11-20, and now 2026-11-24 x2 counted as prior run + this one) across unrelated PRs (#39266, #39548, #39963), all on the ARM64 cross-compilation pipeline, confirming it is a pre-existing flaky test rather than something introduced by PR #40095.
